thread:
Priya: Noticed a steady rise in tiny-gpu Pending + attach failures in eu-west1c since 10:03UTC. Warmpool attach latencies spiking to 12s and a ton of preemptive evictions.
Sam: Is it the scheduler refusing placement because of the new strictAntiAffinity flag? We rolled that at 01:00 UTC.
Priya: Scheduler events show 'bind failed: node had taint gpu.congested=true' followed immediately by a preempt. Logs from attach-service show 'context deadline exceeded' and intermittent ECONNRESET.
Diego: Network path flakiness + stricter anti-affinity sounds like a perfect storm causing fragmentation. Small jobs can't find contiguous free slots so they preempt others.
Helen: Cost dashboard shows increased fallback to on-demand large instances for queued jobs 1% spike in infra egress. Not great.
Sam: Quick options: 1) temporary warmpool scale up in eu-west1c; 2) introduce soft-affinity for tiny-gpu class; 3) rollback strictAffinity flag. Prefer minimizing blast radius.
Priya: Proposal: do (1) + (2) targeted by region. Steps:
- Scale warmpool +15 tiny-gpu in eu-west1c: `warmpoolctl scale --region eu-west1c --pool tiny-gpu --add 15`
- Patch scheduler to allow softAffinity fallback for pods with label `workload.size=tiny-gpu` only in eu-west1c canary 20%:
```
# scheduler patch (canary 20%)
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: sched-policy-eu-west1c
  namespace: kube-system
data:
  json: |
    { "rules": [ { "match": { "labels": { "workload.size": "tiny-gpu" } }, "action": "softAffinityFallback", "percent": 20 } ] }
```
- Monitor: pending count, attach latencies, preempt/sec, and host egress to ensure no larger spill. Check every 5m initially.
Diego: ops-bot, preflight on quotas and any ongoing scheduler config rollouts? @ops-bot
ops-bot: running checks...
ops-bot: preflight ok: warmpool quota available for +15, no active scheduler config rollout detected, attach-service healthy in eu-west1b but showing higher latency in eu-west1c.
Sam: Since attach-service healthy in eu-west1b, add fallback routing for attach service calls coming from eu-west1c to eu-west1b if latency >8s. That avoids immediate rollback.
Priya: I'll apply the warmpool scale and the 20% canary patch now, then add the attach fallback rule. Patch commands queued.
Helen: Add an alert to slack if preemptions/sec > 50 or pending tiny-gpu > 200 for more than 3m.
Diego: Also run a quick packing sim after changes to ensure we don't create cross-AZ spill that will raise egress.
Priya: Changes applied: warmpool +15 succeeded, scheduler canary applied. Early signs: pending count down ~35% on canary nodes, preempt/sec reduced. Attach latencies in eu-west1c still a bit noisy but fallback routing is catching some calls.
Sam: Good. Keep canary for 45m and then ramp to 100% if metrics stable. Opening ticket ENGPLAT-2021 and adding rollback: remove softAffinity fallback + scale down warmpool if regressions.
Priya: Ticket ENGPLAT-2021 created. If anything spikes, revert scheduler config and scale down warmpool. Will post updates. :white_check_mark:
